gloss: critical speed; limiting speed; maximum safe speed

definitions.gloss: critical speed; the maximum speed something can sustain
definitions.explanation: The upper speed at which a vehicle, machine, or moving body can still operate safely or stably; beyond it, control or structural integrity is lost. A technical term in physics and engineering.

examples.japanese: {限界速度|げんかいそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{限界速度|げんかいそくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This machine has a maximum operating speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{限界速度|げんかいそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you exceed the critical speed on a curve, the car may lose control.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧ (limit) plus ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ (speed). It names the speed beyond which safe or stable operation breaks down, and is mostly a technical term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限界速度|げんかいそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the critical speed
- {限界速度|げんかいそくど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach the limiting speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{制限速度|せいげんそくど}→制限速度：26875_seigensokudo⟧: speed limit — the legally set maximum for a road, not a physical limit
- ⟦{最高速度|さいこうそくど}→最高速度：17987_saikousokudo⟧: top speed — the fastest a vehicle can go, without the safety nuance
